title: Remember November 2026 Is Coming Meme Explained
claim: An independent explainer says nobody knows what November brings, that this is the whole joke, and lists the main formats.
excerpt: Search summary across meme.com/KYM/Neon Music results: no verified prediction behind the date; 'collaborative fiction'; popular entries are karaoke covers of the bear song, edits pairing the bear with a November 2026 calendar, and reaction skits.
